vcmp health software(1) 				BIG-IP TMSH Manual				   vcmp health software(1)

NAME
       software - Display vCMP guest software status.

MODULE
       vcmp health

SYNTAX
       Display guest software status using the following syntax.

   DISPLAY
	show software

DESCRIPTION
       Use the software component within the vcmp health module to display software status information about the vCMP guests
       deployed on this system. This is similar to running tmsh show sys software inside the guest.

EXAMPLES
       show vcmp health software

       Display software status for all guests.

       show vcmp health software my_guest

       Display software status for a single guest; "my_guest".

OPTIONS
       For information about the options that you can use with the show command, see help show.
